definitions.genwall_s: Stored wall_s: cached endpoint input to sorted CPU raw events, setup excluded
definitions.initialized_pipeline_s: Stored setup_s+wall_s: includes per-clip initialization and each sensor first frame; pretrained model/private compiled kernel already loaded
definitions.peak_worker_allocated_bytes: Whole worker Torch allocated-memory peak, including persistent model allocations; not device total usage
definitions.peak_reported_bytes: Original per-method peak_bytes; ours subtracts unrelated pre-call allocation, V2E reports whole worker peak
definitions.old_over_new_speedup: median frozen time / median candidate time; >1 means candidate is faster
definitions.candidate_over_v2e_slowdown: median candidate time / median V2E native-auto time; >1 means candidate is slower
definitions.aggregation: Geometric mean of per-case ratios across all five fixed cases, never a ratio of arbitrary average clip times

limitations: No equal-event-quality, temporal-density, or accuracy claim is made for V2E.
Three repeats quantify timing spread; IQR is descriptive and is not a confidence interval.
Physical Genesis rendering, input disk loading and event serialization are excluded.
V2E minimum63 is a separate numerical-step control, not a default or quality-matched configuration.
Normal-mode timing cannot replace the separate deterministic full-output quality gates.
